	OR = {

}

zin_world_pact_cheap = {
	# The Keeper pays less when the roosts trust it: the bond at 70 or more, or the Magical Forest's old pact.
	zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes
	OR = {
		check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_roost_bond value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_old_pact
	}
}
zin_world_pact_trusted = {
	# The Keeper, or a realm the Keeper likes (opinion 50 or more) while the roost bond is 40 or more ("the dragons will not come for strangers").
	OR = {
		zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes
		AND = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_roost_bond value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			any_country = {
				zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes
				ROOT = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 49 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_world_corruption_open = {
	# A Keeper the false god's friends can reach: 3 footholds or more there, or 2 while the bond is below 30 ("The Roosts Are Restless"), and the roosts unguarded.
	any_country = {
		zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes
		NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_roosts_guarded }
		OR = {
			check_variable = { var = zin_footholds value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			AND = {
				check_variable = { var = zin_footholds value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { global.zin_elves_roost_bond < 30 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	# The holder of the Great Wall is at war with a realm that borders a wall state.
